'''Hapor''' was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Choices of One" /> that was located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim's]] [[Hapor system/Legends|Hapor system]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and featured the [[Griren Province]].<ref name="Choices of One" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of both [[Allegiance (novel)|''Allegiance'']] and ''[[Choices of One]]'' to [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. The latter is set three [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the former and also places the [[Water/Legends|water]] dispute on Hapor within that interval of [[Time/Legends|time]].</ref> the [[Hand of Judgment]], a group of five [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Desertion/Legends|deserters]], participated in a minor [[Water/Legends|water]] dispute in the province.<ref name="Choices of One" />

Within three [[Standard month/Legends|months]] of the event, [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] read a report on the Hand of Judgment's involvement in the dispute and subsequently used Hapor as a center point when trying to locate the group. Shortly after, Jade tracked down the Hand of Judgment to the planet [[Elegasso]].<ref name="Choices of One" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hapor was mentioned in the [[2011]] novel ''[[Choices of One]]'', written by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="Choices of One" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Hapor [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Hapor itself, in grid square O-8.<ref name="EAOC" />
